scope: Manual functional probe of actual existing Solo radio session/router and new opt-in preset. No browser, physical-radio acceptance or unit-coverage claim. Setup UI boundary is a minimal DOM probe, not actual browser acceptance.

checks.name: Preset creation preserves raw hardware snapshot and existing shared-stick mapping
Confirm/back use only tested yaw axis with measured centre/endpoints
Other hardware descriptor is rejected rather than silently mapped
Initial held Confirm cannot join or activate; neutral joins without selecting
Four menu directions use right stick and preserve calibrated vertical direction
Yaw right confirms once; read-only native guard observes hold; release rearms
Yaw left produces Back once per deliberate deflection
Changing menu context while Confirm is held requires release
Throttle and all buttons/auxiliary axes cannot activate menu actions
Flight retains right-stick movement; yaw never becomes an attack, pause, pickup or boost
Entering menus from flight with held yaw requires neutral before Confirm
Disconnect and reappearance with held Confirm do not activate
Raw profile capture suppresses radio menus and requires neutral after capture
Semantic actions survive remapped standard gamepad Confirm/Back indices

uiBoundaryChecks.name: Solo setup shows localized opt-in and applies preset
Shared setup hides opt-in and cannot apply it
